title: Black-Box Knowledge Transfer across Distinct Feature Sets
abstract: arXiv:2608.12403v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pre-trained black-box predictive functions encode knowledge distilled from massive datasets and extensive computation. However, when the available input features differ from those the black box expects, direct use is infeasible. We introduce a method for transferring predictive knowledge from the black box to a new, heterogeneous input space. Our approach decomposes the target regression function into a transferable component, which the black box can inform, and a non-transferable component, which captures information unique to the new space. We propose a two-step neural network procedure, estimating the transferable component from abundant unlabeled feature pairs that bridge the two input spaces and the non-transferable component from limited labels. We derive prediction risk bounds that improve on those of a non-transfer alternative when the non-transferable component is small or smooth, and the procedure adapts to either case. Under

translated_title: 跨不同特征集的黑盒知识迁移
translated_abstract: 预训练的黑盒预测函数编码了从海量数据集和大量计算中提炼的知识。然而，当可用输入特征与黑盒期望的特征不同时，直接使用是不可行的。我们提出了一种将预测知识从黑盒迁移到新的异构输入空间的方法。我们的方法将目标回归函数分解为可迁移组件（黑盒可以提供信息）和不可迁移组件（捕获新空间特有的信息）。我们提出了一种两步神经网络过程，从大量无标签特征对中估计可迁移组件（这些特征对桥接两个输入空间），并从有限标签中估计不可迁移组件。我们推导了预测风险界，当不可迁移组件较小或平滑时，这些界优于非迁移替代方案，并且该过程能自适应于任一情况。
tldr: 本文提出了一种黑盒知识迁移方法，通过将回归函数分解为可迁移与不可迁移组件，利用无标签特征对和有限标签实现跨异构特征空间的有效预测，并提供了自适应风险界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a black-box knowledge transfer method that decomposes the regression function into transferable and non-transferable components, using unlabeled feature pairs and limited labels to enable effective prediction across heterogeneous feature spaces, with adaptive risk bounds.
